Question ID: ALG1_U01_L04_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: Readiness Support Only - No primary MLA standard assigned in approved mapping

Evaluate 8 + 3 times 4.

feedback.text: This adds 8 and 3 first. Multiplication must be completed before addition unless grouping symbols change the order.
Complete multiplication first: 3 times 4 = 12. Then 8 + 12 = 20.

This appears to multiply after adding 8 + 3. Addition does not come before multiplication in this expression. This choice reflects a common error or incomplete step. Recheck the mapped lesson method, compare the representation or equation carefully, and identify where the reasoning changes.
This does not follow the operation order. First multiply 3 times 4, then add 8.

Evaluate 5x - 2 when x = 6.

feedback.text: This may come from subtracting before multiplying. Substitute first, then multiply before subtracting.
This stops after 5 times 6. The expression also says to subtract 2.
Substitute 6 for x: 5(6) - 2 = 30 - 2 = 28.
This adds 2 instead of subtracting 2. Check the operation sign after substitution.
